name: VANDIRA Political War Room
purpose: A unified command workspace that consolidates live political signals, alerts, executive briefing, hierarchy context and an evidence-gated decision queue.
evidence_rules: Reported news remains attributed until verified.
Election warehouse facts remain distinct from live political reporting.
2024 Lok Sabha data is never represented as a 2024 Assembly result.
Partial booth detail is never presented as a complete booth universe.
No unsupported 2027 winner prediction or probability.
political_safety: Operational recommendations must be evidence-gated and human-reviewed.
